subject: Partner-led discovery follow-up: next steps & demo scheduling (CloudBridge)
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Great call today — next steps / technical deep dive

Hi Marissa / Mateo,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful conversation. Quick recap from our side: CloudBridge is evaluating a managed inference partner to streamline our marketplace integrations (primary concerns: predictable latency at scale, multi-model routing, and private deployment options for regulated customers).

We'd like to schedule a partner-led technical deep dive/demo next week to:
- Walk through a sample integration flow for marketplace onboarding
- See the Dedicated + Private deployment options and routing/fallback behavior
- Discuss SSO/KMS integration and audit log visibility

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 24 Nov — 10:00–11:00am
- Wed 25 Nov — 2:00–2:45pm
- Thu 26 Nov — 9:00–9:45am

Attaching a one-pager that outlines the use cases we discussed. Priya (cc'd on internal thread at CloudBridge) will join on the call and can share architecture diagrams. Can you confirm availability and which folks from Redwood should present?

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge
(sanjay@cloudbridge.com)

Attachment: cloudbridge-one-pager.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Great call today — next steps / technical deep dive

Thanks, Sanjay — great to meet the CloudBridge team today. Appreciate the clear recap.

We can cover integration flows, Dedicated/Private demos, and SSO/KMS. Suggested presenters: Mateo (solutions lead) will walk through integration + routing, and Jonas (SRE/infra) will handle the deployment, quantization, and observability discussion. I'll run the agenda and timebox items.

Of the slots you proposed, Wed 25 Nov 2:00–2:45pm PST works best for our team. If that’s good for you, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Proposed short agenda (30–45min):
1) 5m: introductions & goals
2) 15m: integration flow + demo (Mateo)
3) 15m: deployment & observability (Jonas)
4) 5–10m: Q&A / next steps (sync on procurement/PoC)

I’ve attached a draft demo agenda and will add a Drive folder after we lock the time.

Marissa Cole
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.md

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Priya Singh <priya@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Great call today — next steps / technical deep dive

Perfect — Wed 25 Nov 2:00–2:45pm PST works for us. I’ve created a calendar invite here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123 (please accept).

Attaching the CloudBridge topology we mentioned. Priya will join and bring both our integrations architect and a PM who will own the marketplace onboarding checklist. For the call, could you add any notes on the SSO/KMS questions we raised? That will help our security team prepare.

Thanks — looking forward to the demo.

—
Sanjay Rao
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge
Attachment: cloudbridge-infra-topology.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Priya Singh <priya@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Great call today — next steps / technical deep dive

Thanks, Sanjay — invite accepted.

Jonas / Mateo: can you please own the technical deep dive deck and slide with SSO/KMS details? I started a shared Drive folder and put the draft agenda there: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C. Jonas — we should include a short slide on audit logs retention and the Dedicated SLA. Mateo — please prepare the integration demo (sample marketplace ingestion flow).

Next steps:
- I’ll pull together a brief pre-read (1 page) for CloudBridge security so they have context before the call.
- Jonas, please attach any slides you want me to share in advance to the Drive folder (technical-deep-dive-slides.pptx).

See you all on Wed 25th at 2pm PST.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
